log.text: ML-TASK-010 delivered: tolerance record with error models, formulas and evaluated values for VT-01…VT-16 and VI-02/03, margin 4; ten open items (solver criterion, atan2 extraction, degenerate thresholds, display resolution…) and four requirement-wording conflicts. Citations unconfirmed. PR #12; Architect review started.

ML-TASK-013 delivered: constants with cited source and 3-vector / 3×3 math, 37 new tests. Coordinator re-ran all checks (375 tests pass) and independently read GM and the semi-major axis in the cited NGA document. The WGS 84 standard itself (TR8350.2) was not reachable, so VT-19 stays open. PR #11.
Phase 1 started in isolated worktrees: ML-TASK-010 tolerance derivation (Verification, opus) and ML-TASK-013 constants, units and vector math (Astrodynamics, opus).
Instructed the merge of PRs #7, #8 and #9 after CI passed. Contracts v1.0 approved. Phase 0b exit criterion met: CI passing, `main` protected, contracts approved.
GitHub Actions recovered. CI passes on PR #8 and PR #9; PR #7 re-triggered with an empty commit because its run stayed stuck.

Owner approved the install. Dev machine: Python 3.13.17 (user scope) and Eclipse Temurin JDK 21.0.13 via winget; virtual environment at `C:devmission-lab-toolsorekit-venv` with `orekit-jpype` 13.1.9.0 and JPype1 1.7.1. Smoke test: JVM starts and Orekit classes load. No orbit computed yet.

ML-TASK-012 part A delivered: Wakker's textbook assessed from its text layer only (formulas and figures not readable). Verdict: good citation source for closed-form relations, weak L3 (few examples, 3–5 significant digits). Committed locally, not pushed pending the owner's decision on publishing book values.

ML-TASK-020 delivered: static workspace mock-up with five result states, design tokens with computed contrast ratios, three owner choices. Not yet rendered in a browser by the team; published privately for the owner.

Started in isolated worktrees, independent of the CI outage: ML-TASK-020 visual direction mock-up (Frontend, sonnet) and ML-TASK-012 part A, assessment of Wakker's textbook as an L3 source (Verification, opus). Remote Control enabled so the owner can follow from the phone.

CI blocked by a GitHub incident: githubstatus.com reports a major outage of Actions ("Impact across multiple GitHub products including Actions, Pages, and Copilot"). Rerun, force-cancel and reopening PR #8 had no effect. Nine runs queued since 20:22 UTC. To be re-triggered when GitHub recovers.

ML-TASK-004 revision 2: nine owner decisions and the reviewers' non-blocking items applied; test count 120 → 338. Coordinator re-ran install, lint, typecheck, test, format and boundary checks: all pass.

Approved the nine contract decisions as recommended (constants in the request, normative sampling grid, semantic errors as validation issues, degenerate angles, bit-exact maneuver boundary enforced in v1.0, interim stale detection, array ownership, bit-pattern number encoding for the request id, fifth UI state). ML-UX-001 amended. Architect started the revision.

Verification review of PR #7 recorded: approve with changes, 4 blocking (sampling grid, semantic rejections, degenerate angles, reference radius) and a list of untested boundaries. The three reviews agree on the main points.

PR #7 reviews recorded: Frontend (3 blocking: semantic-error routing, stale detection before the hash exists, typed-array ownership) and Astrodynamics (2 blocking: constants in the request, exact sampling grid). Both approve with changes.
`main` protected: pull request required, checks `checks` and `e2e` required, admins included, no force push. A direct push test was rejected by GitHub. ML-TASK-005 done.
PRs #4, #5 and #6 merged on the owner's explicit instruction. ML-TASK-006 and ML-TASK-007 done; ML-SYS-001 v0.3 is the approved spec.
CI green on PR #4 after replacing the Chromium install step (first run failed on a runner DNS error fetching apt packages). The three contract reviewers stalled without output and were relaunched.
Started the three role reviews of PR #7 required by the backlog: Astrodynamics (opus), Verification (opus), Frontend (sonnet), all read-only.

ML-TASK-004 delivered: zod schemas and types for Scenario, Request and Result, code registry, `contracts-v1.md`; 120 tests pass (re-run by the Coordinator). 5 additive deviations and 8 open questions for the owner. PR #7 open.
